Upload(byte[], long)

Uploads data to the GPU buffer. For vertex/index buffers, make sure to specify the stride of your vertex structure or use the generic version taking a struct[]

public void Upload(byte[] data, long strideInBytes = 1)

Parameters

data byte[]

The byte array containing the data to upload.

strideInBytes long

The stride of a single entry. This is mostly useful for things like vertex/index buffers, since with a wrong stride it'll do garbage.

Upload<T>(in T)

Uploads a struct to the GPU buffer, automatically inferring the stride from the struct type.
